shared_process.title: Define the topic

shared_process.text: Prepare slides, talking points, examples and whether the format is direct-to-camera or presentation-led.

shared_process.title: Prepare reuse

faq.question: Can Birdcast record webinars?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast can support webinar-style recording, expert sessions, presentations and educational content.

faq.question: Can I record a presentation in the studio?
faq.answer: Yes. The studio can be used for presentation-led videos, expert sessions and structured educational content.

faq.question: Can webinar content become a course?
faq.answer: Yes. Webinar recordings can often be repurposed into course modules, learning content or client education assets.

faq.question: Should I bring slides?
faq.answer: If slides are part of the content, prepare them before the session and discuss the recording flow with the team.

faq.question: What should I prepare before the webinar recording?
faq.answer: Send the webinar topic, number of speakers, slide plan, expected duration and preferred delivery date.
